final: SELECT s5.City, SUM(s5.cnt) as sum_cnt, AVG(s5.diff) as avg_diff, AVG(s5.ratio) as avg_ratio FROM (SELECT s3.SupportRepId, s3.City, s3.cnt, s3.diff, CAST(s3.cnt AS REAL) / s4.total_sum as ratio FROM (SELECT s1.SupportRepId, s1.City, s1.cnt, s1.cnt - s2.avg_cnt as diff FROM (SELECT c.SupportRepId, e.City, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM Customer c JOIN Employee e ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId GROUP BY c.SupportRepId, e.City) s1 JOIN (SELECT City, AVG(cnt) as avg_cnt FROM (SELECT c.SupportRepId, e.City, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM Customer c JOIN Employee e ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId GROUP BY c.SupportRepId, e.City) inner_s1 GROUP BY City) s2 ON s1.City = s2.City WHERE s1.cnt > s2.avg_cnt) s3 CROSS JOIN (SELECT SUM(cnt) as total_sum FROM (SELECT s1.SupportRepId, s1.City, s1.cnt, s1.cnt - s2.avg_cnt as diff FROM (SELECT c.SupportRepId, e.City, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM Customer c JOIN Employee e ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId GROUP BY c.SupportRepId, e.City) s1 JOIN (SELECT City, AVG(cnt) as avg_cnt FROM (SELECT c.SupportRepId, e.City, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM Customer c JOIN Employee e ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId GROUP BY c.SupportRepId, e.City) inner_s1 GROUP BY City) s2 ON s1.City = s2.City WHERE s1.cnt > s2.avg_cnt) s3_inner) s4 WHERE s4.total_sum IS NOT NULL) s5 GROUP BY s5.City
